protocol.checkpointSelection: Use the final update for all comparisons.
protocol.primaryMetric: Strict episode success on all twenty paired test scenarios.
protocol.secondaryMetric: Total verified on-time units divided by total committed units.
protocol.reward: On-time unit fraction plus 0.5 for strict success, less 0.02 times budget fraction spent and 0.002 per rejected action.
protocol.menu: Up to two booking choices per yard, a stock inquiry, a route or supplier inquiry, one purchase and a clock advance. Quantities come from observable stock, capacity, uncommitted demand and budget.

schedules.balanced: Cycle the five training families in protocol order.
schedules.adaptive: Start each family at success estimate 0.5. Sample with 20% uniform coverage and 80% proportional to (0.2 + 1 - success estimate) squared. Update selected family after each group with smoothing 0.2 and the three sampled terminal successes.
